title: Distributor Expense Reimbursement Claims
summary: Check distributor claims for salesman salaries, transport, rent and other reimbursable costs against your policy, field activity and proofs before finance credits them.

seo.title: Distributor Expense Claims Verification | VipraTech
seo.description: Verify distributor claims for salesman salaries, transport and other reimbursements against policy, field app activity and proofs before credit.

problem.intro: Many FMCG brands reimburse part of what distributors spend on running the brand's business: salaries of distributor salesmen who sell only the brand, delivery vehicles, warehouse rent and promoters. These claims arrive monthly with salary sheets, attendance, vehicle logs and bills, and are often settled on trust.

pain_points.title: Salesmen who did not work the beat
pain_points.detail: Salary claims cover salesmen with no orders, no visits or no attendance in the field app for the month.

pain_points.title: Rates above policy
pain_points.detail: Reimbursement caps by role, town class and vehicle type are applied inconsistently.

pain_points.title: Bills that do not prove the cost
pain_points.detail: Fuel, rent and vehicle bills are missing, round-figure or repeated month after month.

pain_points.title: Claims that drift up quietly
pain_points.detail: Monthly amounts creep up without anyone comparing them with the distributor's sales or earlier months.

solution.overview: VipraTech checks each expense claim against your reimbursement policy and your own data. Salary claims are matched to salesmen in the field sales app, with their attendance, visits and orders for the month. Transport and rent claims are checked against caps by town class and vehicle type, and against bills. Claims are compared with the distributor's sales and earlier months to spot unusual jumps. Lines that pass go to the credit note sheet, and the rest go to sales finance with the reason.
capabilities: Reimbursement policy as rules: caps by role, town class, vehicle and period
Matches salary claims to field app attendance, visits and orders
Reads salary sheets, vehicle logs and bills
Flags claims above caps, without proof or out of line with sales
Trend view of each distributor's claims against sales
Credit note sheet and audit trail

workflow.title: Receive claims
workflow.detail: Distributors send salary sheets, attendance, vehicle logs and bills.

workflow.title: Read and normalise
workflow.detail: Each claim is read into distributor, cost type, person or vehicle, period and amount.

workflow.title: Match to field data
workflow.detail: Salesmen are matched to field app attendance, visits and orders for the month.

workflow.title: Apply policy
workflow.detail: Caps and eligibility are applied, and the reimbursable amount is recalculated.

workflow.title: Review
workflow.detail: Lines above caps, without proof or out of line with sales go to sales finance.

workflow.title: Approve and credit
workflow.detail: Finance approves the credit note sheet.

inputs: Vehicle logs, fuel and rent bills
outputs: Flags for missing activity, missing proof or amounts above caps
Credit note sheet for finance approval
human_in_the_loop: Sales finance decides on flagged lines, with the regional sales manager where needed, and finance approves every credit. Field activity data is evidence for a person to weigh, not an automatic rejection.
integrations: ERP such as SAP or Tally for credit notes
guardrails: No salary reimbursement without a matched salesman
Caps applied from the policy version for the period
Every credit linked to its bills and activity data
compliance_notes: The system keeps the supporting bills and activity with each reimbursed line, whichever way your finance team settles reimbursements.

pilot.scope: One month of expense claims for the distributors of one region, with finance-settled amounts as the benchmark.
deliverables: Credit note sheet in your format

what_we_measure.how: Share of salary lines matched to a salesman active in the field app.
Lines reduced or rejected under policy, confirmed by finance.
Time to review a month of expense claims, compared with today.

faqs.q: What if our field app data is incomplete?
faqs.a: The system shows the activity it found for each salesman. Gaps are flagged for review rather than treated as proof that the person did not work.

faqs.q: Can it handle different caps by town and role?
faqs.a: Yes. Caps can vary by town class, role, vehicle type and period, and the version valid for each month is applied.
Yes, if you choose. Each distributor can get a statement showing what was reimbursed and why lines were reduced.

faqs.q: Is this the same system as your distributor claims settlement?
faqs.a: Yes. It runs on the same claims engine as our live distributor claims settlement, configured to your reimbursement policy during a pilot.
